The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm. It holds a mound of rice, roughly 10 cm across, topped with green salsa and diced tomato, plus 2-3 strips of bacon.

Rice: about 120 g, since the mound is small but fairly thick. Cooked rice runs about 1.3 kcal/g, so that is about 150 kcal.

Salsa and tomato: about 40 g, roughly 20 kcal.

Bacon: about 2 slices, roughly 15 g, at about 5 kcal/g, so about 75 kcal.

Total mass is about 175 g and total energy is about 245 kcal. The rice may have been cooked with some oil, so I'll round the energy up to 260 kcal.
